title: Where can you fly direct from Shannon Airport?
author: Matt
intro: Shannon is a small airport with a big reach: Ryanair flies to sun spots and cities across Europe, Aer Lingus flies to Heathrow, and in summer there are direct flights to New York, Boston and Chicago with US preclearance. In winter, Ryanair flies to Lapland. Here's what flies and when.
seo_title: Where can you fly direct from Shannon? (2026 guide)
seo_description: Ryanair flies most routes, including Lapland in winter; Aer Lingus flies to Heathrow; summer brings New York, Boston and Chicago. Checked Nov 2026.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Main airline:** Ryanair
- **London:** Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted
- **Winter extra:** Lapland
- **USA:** mostly summer only

We checked these routes in November 2026. Shannon's schedule changes a lot between summer and winter, so check the airline's timetable or the airport's route guide before you plan a trip around one.

sections.heading: Who flies from Shannon
sections.text:
Ryanair is Shannon's biggest airline, with four aircraft based there and a record 30 routes in summer 2026. Its winter schedule is smaller, focused on the UK, Spain, Portugal and a few winter extras.

Aer Lingus flies daily to London Heathrow, which is handy for connections across the world on one ticket. In summer, Aer Lingus and US airlines add direct flights across the Atlantic.

sections.heading: Winter routes worth knowing
sections.text:
| Destination | Airline | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Rovaniemi](/destinations/rovaniemi), Lapland | Ryanair | winter only, for Santa trips and snow |
| London Heathrow | Aer Lingus | daily, good for connections |
| Gatwick and Stansted | Ryanair | London and onward flights |
| [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) | Ryanair | weekly winter sun last winter |
| [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) | Ryanair | winter sun |
| [Madeira](/destinations/madeira) | Ryanair | added for winter 2025/26 |
| [Kraków](/destinations/krakow) | Ryanair | city breaks and Christmas markets |

Routes like Gran Canaria and Madeira may only fly once or twice a week, so check the flight days first. Ryanair also flies from Shannon to UK cities such as Manchester, Birmingham, Liverpool and Edinburgh.

sections.heading: Lapland from Shannon
sections.text:
Ryanair's Rovaniemi flights make Lapland one of the easiest winter trips from the west of Ireland, with no change in Dublin or London. Rovaniemi is the home of Santa Claus Village, right on the Arctic Circle, a short drive from the airport.

December is the busiest and most expensive month, with highs around -6°C and very short days. January to March is quieter and colder, with longer days and a better chance of the northern lights. Our guide to the [quietest time to visit Lapland](/blog/quietest-time-to-visit-lapland) has more.

Tip: on a once or twice weekly route, the flight days fix the length of your trip. Book flights first, then the accommodation to match.

sections.heading: Flights to the US
sections.text:
Shannon's transatlantic flights are mostly seasonal. In summer 2026, Aer Lingus flew to [Boston](/destinations/boston), with up to ten flights a week at the peak, and Delta to [New York](/destinations/new-york) JFK and United to [Chicago](/destinations/chicago) returned for the season. Check what's flying on your dates, as winter service is much thinner.

Shannon has full US preclearance, so you go through US immigration before you board and land in America as a domestic passenger. Allow at least three hours at the airport.

Watch out: you need an approved ESTA or a US visa before you fly. Preclearance can refuse boarding at Shannon if your paperwork isn't in order.

sections.heading: City breaks and summer routes
sections.text: In summer, Ryanair's Shannon schedule grows to around 30 routes, with summer 2026 adding [Rome](/destinations/rome), [Madrid](/destinations/madrid), Warsaw and Poznań. [Málaga](/destinations/malaga), Faro for the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve) and [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) are the regular sun routes. Our guide to [how early to arrive at Shannon Airport](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-shannon-airport) covers security, the two-litre liquids rule and the 343 bus from Limerick.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Shannon?
sections.text:
For a winter adventure, try [Rovaniemi](/destinations/rovaniemi). For a week of sun, look at [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) or [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria). For a city break, try [Kraków](/destinations/krakow) or [Madrid](/destinations/madrid). The [Christmas holidays](/destinations/christmas-holidays) and [holidays in the USA](/destinations/holidays-in-the-usa) pages have more ideas.

If your family can't agree, read our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday), or add a few ideas to somewhere.party and let the draw decide.

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from Shannon Airport?
faqs.answer: Mainly Ryanair, which has four aircraft based there, and Aer Lingus, which flies to London Heathrow. US airlines add transatlantic flights in summer.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Shannon to Lapland?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ryanair flies from Shannon to Rovaniemi in winter. Check the days of the week before booking accommodation.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Shannon to America?
faqs.answer: Yes, mostly in summer. Aer Lingus flies to Boston, and Delta and United have flown to New York and Chicago. You clear US preclearance in Shannon.

faqs.question: Does Shannon have flights to Heathrow?
faqs.answer: Yes. Aer Lingus flies daily from Shannon to London Heathrow, which is useful for onward connections.
